result.instructions: Tools for SmartEmailing, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contact lists do we have and how many contacts are in each?"; "Show the e-mail campaigns sent this month with their open and click totals."; "Find the contact with the address jane@example.com and list the custom fields she has.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartEmailing data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartemailing_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartemailing_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartemailing_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smartemailing_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartemailing_account_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: Return basic information about the SmartEmailing account these credentials belong to. Good first call to confirm the connection. API: GET /account-info.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List contact lists (audiences) in the account with their names and settings. API: GET /contactlists.

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

sort.description: Comma separated sort keys. Prefix a key with - for descending order.

limit.description: Records per page (max 500 on most lists).

tools.name: smartemailing_get_contact_list
tools.title: Get contact list
tools.description: Return one contact list by its ID. API: GET /contactlists/{id}.

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contacts_in_list
tools.title: List contacts in a list
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one contact list. API: GET /contactlists/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: smartemailing_create_contact_list
tools.title: Create contact list
tools.description: Create a new contact list with the given name. Creates a record in the account: it does not send any e-mail. API: POST /contactlists.

name.description: Contact list name (not shown to the public).

publicname.description: Contact list name shown to the public.

senderemail.description: E-mail of the list owner. Must be confirmed in SmartEmailing.

replyto.description: Reply-to e-mail. Must be confirmed in SmartEmailing.

tools.name: smartemailing_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts across the account, with optional filters on e-mail, name, company, country and blacklist status. API: GET /contacts.

blacklisted.description: Filter by blacklist status: 1 blacklisted, 0 not.

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

sort.description: Comma separated sort keys. Prefix a key with - for descending order.

limit.description: Records per page (max 500 on most lists).

tools.name: smartemailing_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Return one contact by its e-mail address (or numeric contact ID). Set expand_customfields to include custom field values. API: GET /contacts/{emailaddress}.

emailaddress.description: Contact e-mail address or numeric contact ID.

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

expand_customfields.description: Include the contact's custom field values.

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

sort.description: Comma separated sort keys. Prefix a key with - for descending order.

expand_options.description: Include the options of select-type fields.

limit.description: Records per page (max 500 on most lists).

select.description: Comma separated properties to return, for example id,emailaddress. Omit for the default fields.

tools.name: smartemailing_get_email_performance
tools.title: Get email performance overview
tools.description: Return delivery, open and click totals for sent e-mails, optionally grouped by time, domain or engagement level. API: GET /email-performance-overview.

detail.description: brief: totals only. full: more detail.

group_by.description: Comma separated grouping, for example time:month or domain. Values: email_statistic_id, domain, infra_provider, engagement_level, time:year, time:month, time:week, time:day.

email_statistic_ids.description: Comma separated statistic IDs to include.

domains.description: Comma separated recipient domains to include, for example seznam.cz,gmail.com.
